decisions.decision: 999.17.3 sub-phase carve-out from 999.17.1 Plan 04 Task 4 — mirrors 999.17.2 pattern (carve out, work, sub-phase merge back, resume parent)
decisions.rationale: 22 pnpm-audit findings are real production hygiene work that warrants its own GSD cycle (research -> plan -> execute -> verify), not ad-hoc bumps in the middle of UAT. Carve-out preserves Plan 04 Task 4 as a focused orchestrator-behavior test once baseline is clean.

Overrides force transitive versions without updating parents — they mask upstream's failure to update, can break peer-dep contracts, and defeat the security gate's purpose (gate should enforce dep hygiene, not teach how to bypass). Direct-dep upgrades only: bump our @nestjs/*, eslint, turbo, etc. to versions that pull in patched transitives naturally.
